title: Opioid Addiction (Heroin, Morphine & Prescription Painkillers)
sourceFile: Opioid addiction (e.g., heroin, morphine, prescription painkillers).pdf
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals recovering from opioid addiction.
Recovery from opioid dependence often involves physical, emotional, and psychological healing. These
affirmations encourage hope, resilience, self-compassion, and perseverance while reinforcing the

courage it takes to choose recovery every day. They are intended to complement professional medical
care, medication-assisted treatment (when prescribed), counseling, and peer support.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder: Opioid recovery often requires medical support, including medication-assisted treatment when prescribed. Seek urgent care for overdose risk or severe withdrawal. This programme complements professional care and is not a substitute for medical detox or clinical treatment.
safety.escalation: Opioid withdrawal and overdose risk require medical support. Naloxone and emergency services may be life-saving. This programme is not a substitute for clinical care.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by opioid addiction or my past. I am defined by my courage to begin again, my
strength to keep moving forward, and my commitment to healing. Every day I choose recovery, I
reclaim my health, restore my hope, and build a future filled with purpose, peace, and freedom.
One day, one choice, and one step at a time, I am creating a life of lasting recovery.
